'''Kiyono Yasuno''' (Japanese: '''安野希世乃''' ''Yasuno Kiyono'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Yasuno was born on July 9, 1989, in {{wp|Miyagi Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}. As a child, she became interested in anime after watching a few notable works, and then became aware of voice acting. During her high school years, she passed an audition held by the {{wp|Tokyo}}-based talent agency {{wp|Avex Group}} and joined its voice acting school, paying with her own money at the request of her parents. Beginning in 2009, Yasuno started her voice acting career and then played her first lead role in 2011. She rose to fame over the years and even became a singer, releasing mini-albums and performing songs for anime series. Yasuno became involved with {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|BW}}, but her best-known role was as [[Professor Sycamore]]'s assistant [[Cosette]] during {{aniseries|XY}}.
